summary.text: Doug Owens is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 33 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Doug Owens was born in Salt Lake City, Utah.
He earned a B.A. from the University of Utah in 1984 and a law degree from Yale Law School in 1989, according to Ballotpedia.
In the 2023-2024 legislative term, Owens was assigned to the House Ethics Committee, the House Natural Resources, Agriculture, and Environment Committee and the House Revenue and Taxation Committee.
